positive.prompt: Break this spec into small verifiable tasks with acceptance criteria
Turn the PRD into an ordered task list we can execute
Plan the work into implementable chunks before we start coding

negative.prompt: Encode the output so it is safe against XSS

evals.prompt: Break the attached notifications spec into an executable plan.
evals.expected_output: Ordered tasks in tasks/plan.md, each small, verifiable, with acceptance criteria and dependencies
expectations: Tasks are vertical slices rather than horizontal layers
No implementation code is written during planning

evals.prompt: Read worker-lifecycle/INTERFACE.md and worker-lifecycle/completed.md. Write the requested plan and task list without executing worker operations or changing the supplied fixtures.
evals.expected_output: A plan that refreshes status, dispatches new version-2 assignments to the completed and idle workers, and verifies actual execution rather than accepting the earlier delivery receipt.
expectations: The plan records reviewer-a as completed after version 1 and reviewer-b as idle with no assignment; neither is falsely described as running version 2
The next permitted execution step uses inspect and then dispatch for each eligible worker, rather than another message-only continuation
The earlier delivered message is not counted as a started task or completed review
Acceptance requires evidence that the version-2 assignments actually started and produced the requested review artifacts
The plan rechecks status and assignment before execution, preserves the supplied file scope, and does not grant publication or merge rights
The trace creates tasks/plan.md and tasks/todo.md but performs no worker operations and leaves the fixture files unchanged

evals.prompt: Read worker-lifecycle/INTERFACE.md and worker-lifecycle/running.md. Write the requested plan and task list without executing worker operations or changing the supplied fixtures.
evals.expected_output: A plan that refreshes the running worker's existing version-2 assignment, sends the clarification with message, and waits for that result without dispatching duplicate work.
expectations: The plan records reviewer-a as running an assignment that already covers the requested version-2 review
The next permitted operations are to inspect current status and assignment, send the clarification using message, and wait for the existing result
The plan does not dispatch the same assignment again or start a replacement reviewer merely because a clarification was needed
A delivered message is not described as proof that the clarification was applied or the review finished; acceptance checks the returned artifact
The trace creates tasks/plan.md and tasks/todo.md without executing worker operations, writing implementation code or modifying fixture files
